Documentation.short_help: SHYX AI Assistant: chat and write ParaView Python. Apply runs the code box.
Documentation.long_help: Optional-input pass-through. Send to AI calls an OpenAI-compatible chat/completions endpoint. Apply executes the code box via ParaView's Python interpreter (paraview.simple), not RequestData. Connected input is shallow-copied; without input the output is empty vtkPolyData.

InputProperty.name: Input
InputProperty.Documentation: Optional. When connected, this node pass-throughs the dataset.

StringVectorProperty.label: Question
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Current user question. Send to AI uses this box.

StringVectorProperty.label: Code

StringVectorProperty.Documentation: ParaView Python (paraview.simple). Apply executes this script.

StringVectorProperty.name: DialogHistory

StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Multi-turn conversation transcript sent as context.

StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Model id for the OpenAI-compatible chat/completions API.
